mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tool_confirmations (confirmation_id, conversation_id, app_name, user_id, session_id, invocation_id, adk_call_id, tool_name, request_message, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{confirmationId}, #{conversationId}, #{appName}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{invocationId}, #{adkCallId}, #{toolName}, #{requestMessage}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = VALUES(updated_at), request_message = VALUES(request_message), tool_name = VALUES(tool_name)
